# `integrations/azure-devops.ts` API Reference

This module provides utilities for interacting with the Azure DevOps REST API. It covers common pull request workflows including creation, retrieval, and commenting, as well as repository name parsing.

## Interfaces

### `AzureDevOpsPR`

Represents an Azure DevOps pull request object.

| Member | Type     | Description                        |
|--------|----------|------------------------------------|
| `id`   | `number` | The unique identifier of the PR.   |
| `url`  | `string` | The URL of the pull request.       |
| `status` | `string` | The current status of the PR.    |

---

## Functions

### `parseAdoRepoName`

Parses an Azure DevOps repo full name into its components. The expected format is `"org/project/repo"`.

```ts
import { parseAdoRepoName } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name       | Type     | Description                                      |
|------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `fullName` | `string` | The full repository name in `org/project/repo` format. |

#### Returns

`{ org: string; project: string; repo: string; }`

| Field     | Type     | Description                      |
|-----------|----------|----------------------------------|
| `org`     | `string` | The Azure DevOps organization.   |
| `project` | `string` | The project within the org.      |
| `repo`    | `string` | The repository name.             |

#### Example

```ts
const { org, project, repo } = parseAdoRepoName('my-org/my-project/my-repo');
// org     => 'my-org'
// project => 'my-project'
// repo    => 'my-repo'
```

### `createPullRequest`

Creates a pull request in Azure DevOps.

```ts
import { createPullRequest } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name           | Type     | Description                                      |
|----------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `org`          | `string` | The Azure DevOps organization name.              |
| `project`      | `string` | The project within the organization.             |
| `repo`         | `string` | The target repository name.                      |
| `sourceBranch` | `string` | The branch to merge from.                        |
| `targetBranch` | `string` | The branch to merge into.                        |
| `title`        | `string` | The title of the pull request.                   |
| `description`  | `string` | The description body of the pull request.        |
| `pat`          | `string` | A Personal Access Token for authentication.      |

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; url: string; }>`

| Field | Type     | Description                          |
|-------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `id`  | `number` | The ID of the newly created PR.      |
| `url` | `string` | The URL of the newly created PR.     |

#### Example

```ts
const { id, url } = await createPullRequest(
  'my-org',
  'my-project',
  'my-repo',
  'feature/my-branch',
  'main',
  'My PR Title',
  'A description of the changes.',
  'my-personal-access-token'
);
```

| `prId`    | `number` | The ID of the pull request to comment on.   |

### `getPullRequest`

Gets a pull request by ID.

```ts
import { getPullRequest } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type     | Description                                 |
|-----------|----------|---------------------------------------------|
| `org`     | `string` | The Azure DevOps organization name.         |
| `project` | `string` | The project within the organization.        |
| `repo`    | `string` | The repository name.                        |
| `prId`    | `number` | The ID of the pull request to retrieve.     |
| `pat`     | `string` | A Personal Access Token for authentication. |

#### Returns

`Promise<AzureDevOpsPR>`

Returns a promise that resolves to an [`AzureDevOpsPR`](#azuredevopspr) object.

#### Example

```ts
const pr = await getPullRequest(
  'my-org',
  'my-project',
  'my-repo',
  42,
  'my-personal-access-token'
);

console.log(pr.status); // e.g. 'active'
```

### `getPRThreadComments`

Gets all comments from PR threads in Azure DevOps. Thread comments are flattened into a single list.

```ts
import { getPRThreadComments } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type     | Description                                 |
|-----------|----------|---------------------------------------------|
| `org`     | `string` | The Azure DevOps organization name.         |
| `project` | `string` | The project within the organization.        |
| `repo`    | `string` | The repository name.                        |
| `prId`    | `number` | The ID of the pull request.                 |
| `pat`     | `string` | A Personal Access Token for authentication. |

#### Returns

`Promise<{ id: number; body: string; author: string; createdAt: string; }[]>`

Returns a promise that resolves to a flat array of comment objects.

| Field       | Type     | Description                              |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------|
| `id`        | `number` | The unique identifier of the comment.    |
| `body`      | `string` | The text content of the comment.         |
| `author`    | `string` | The display name of the comment author.  |
| `createdAt` | `string` | The ISO 8601 timestamp of the comment.   |

#### Example

```ts
const comments = await getPRThreadComments(
  'my-org',
  'my-project',
  'my-repo',
  42,
  'my-personal-access-token'
);

for (const comment of comments) {
  console.log(`[${comment.author}] ${comment.body}`);
}
```
